name: def-conn-var
reason: Macro registering a global into the per-connection variable rebinding list. The cross-DB rebinding pattern is gone — each Ctx owns its caches directly.

name: defcache
reason: Macro registering a cache + defining init-cache method. Rust shape has no registry; each cache is a typed Ctx field with hand-written accessor.

name: dp
reason: Debug-printer wrapper around *debug*. Replaced by the tracing crate's emit + filter level.

reason: Generic-function lazy-init on a cache name. Per-cache lazy access becomes a method on Ctx over its OnceCell field.

name: get-cache
reason: Looks up a cache instance from the class-side hash by name. Subsumed by typed-field access on Ctx; no name->instance dispatch.

name: get-spec
reason: Lisp dbid-dispatch (nil/list/keyword → connection spec) doesn't translate. Connection registry will be handled via the Rust config crate when the DB layer lands.

name: init-all-caches

name: let-db

name: load-settings
reason: Loads settings.lisp and overrides connection from env. No counterpart in Rust — config comes from env (or layered config-crate sources) via Ctx::from_env.

name: reset-cache
reason: Generic-function force-rebuild of a named cache. Per-cache reset becomes a method on Ctx; no name->instance dispatch.

name: switch-conn-vars
reason: Per-connection variable rebinding from *conn-var-cache*. Rust has no dynamic-variable shadowing; replaced by per-Database struct ownership of caches when the DB layer lands. Same family as all-caches / get-spec.

name: with-db
reason: Rebinds *connection* and re-derives per-conn-var cache for a dynamic scope. Replaced by per-Ctx ownership of pool and caches; multi-DB = construct another Ctx.

name: with-log
reason: Wraps cl-postgres:*query-log* to a stream for the body. Replaced by sqlx + tracing query logging.

name: *init-suffixes-lock*
reason: SBCL mutex guarding init-suffixes-thread's populator and powering init-suffixes-running-p. Subsumed by OnceLock::get_or_init's built-in once-only synchronization on *suffix-cache* / *suffix-class*; no standalone mutex survives.

name: *special-counters*
reason: Doc-only stub: registry value-fn type depends on the unported cache populator (wave 110); storage home depends on the unbuilt KaniranContext::Inner. Re-port as ported once both prerequisites land.

name: init-suffix-hashtables
reason: Empty-hashtable initializer for *suffix-cache* / *suffix-class* def-conn-vars. Rust replacement is OnceLock<HashMap> populated on first read; no standalone init verb survives.

name: init-suffixes-running-p
reason: Loader-busy predicate over a one-shot init thread + def-conn-var cache. Rust replacement is OnceLock::get().is_some() or eager startup init; the verb has nowhere to live.
